The '''Gopps Forest''' was located near the city of [[Tiems]]. During the [[Battle of Tiems]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces used the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] as cover while engaging [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]].
